source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned port updates a disabled-feature preference and the matching html.css/ua.css unknown-property expressions to text-decoration-inset. It leaves shipping CSS untouched. Current ignoredError requires all supplied source/message regexes to match and records use; it does not test isFromDevTools. The separate unused-rule check applies to thunderbirdIgnoreList. The test asserts zero unmatched CSS errors, but no parser run was performed for this study.
title: The CSS parse port renames a conditional error exception rather than enabling a feature
